title: Extend equity and digital-inclusion safeguards across the guidance
requirements:
- Address variation in functional ability, language, literacy and digital capability as architectural concerns
- Require a non-digital route of equivalent standing for functions on which rights or entitlements depend
- Require assessment of distributional effects of major decisions (who gains access, who bears burden, who is excluded)
- Add an inclusion workstream across profiling, procurement, testing, rollout and financing
- Do not assume person and health worker share a language; cover assisted and non-digital pathways
- Distinguish value that requires individual activation from value that does not
- Address overlapping disadvantage and populations missing from formal datasets where lawful and proportionate
- Address digital literacy of health workers and patients
